description.value:
Darkness gathers around you: dim light within 10 feet of you becomes darkness, and bright light within that radius becomes dim, leaving you heavily obscured.

For the duration you have resistance to force damage, and any creature within 10 feet of you that hits you with an attack takes 2d8 necrotic damage.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 4
